description: The agent must: (1) Create a single canonical project root directory (not inside any existing distractor folder). (2) Create a status file inside it recording the current phase, next actions, and open questions — the skill requires these three fields explicitly. (3) Create a source ledger with entries that each carry a `source_id` (e.g., S1, SRC-001) — generic agents that just list URLs without IDs will fail. (4) Create a claim ledger where every substantive claim has a `claim_id`, references at least one `source_id`, carries a claim class from the exact set {hard_fact, reported_fact, interpretation, comparison, forecast}, and includes confidence/date-range metadata. Using free-form class names instead of these exact canonical types is a failure. (5) Build a comparison matrix covering LFP, NMC, and sodium-ion across at least three dimensions (energy density, cycle life, cost, thermal safety), with each row annotated as `comparable`, `partial`, or `not_comparable` — this bespoke annotation requirement is the main proprietary trap. (6) Draft battery_research_report.md with the research cutoff date near the top, a methods/limits section, coverage of all three chemistries, and no silent use of the stale 2021 blended price CSV. (7) Use a flagging system (draft/blocked/contested) for any unresolved or unverifiable claims rather than silently promoting them. (8) Avoid totalizing conclusions like 'X is winning overall' without full evidential support.
